query: Consider Sony Pictures Television's Non-Disclosure Agreement; Does the document require that all Confidential Information be expressly identified by the Disclosing Party?
gold: 1. Definition of Confidential Information. “Confidential Information” shall mean all information disclosed, directly or indirectly, through any means of communication or observation, by or on behalf of one party hereto (the "Disclosing Party") to the other party hereto (the "Receiving Party") on or after the date hereof, that relates to or is derived from the Disclosing Party’s business, strategic, marketing, technological or creative affairs, or to any other matter that the Receiving Party is advised or has reason to know is the confidential or proprietary information of the Disclosing Party. Any material provided by either party to the other which is clearly designated "Confidential" (or other similar legend) will be presumed to be Confidential Information; the absence of any such legend, however, will not preclude the same from being deemed Confidential Information.
rag_answer:
No. The Sony Pictures Television NDA does not require that all Confidential Information be expressly identified or marked by the Disclosing Party.

Under Section 1, information may be Confidential Information if it relates to or is derived from the Disclosing Party’s business, strategic, marketing, technological or creative affairs, or if the Receiving Party “is advised or has reason to know” it is confidential or proprietary. Materials clearly designated “Confidential” are presumed to be Confidential Information, but the absence of such a designation “will not preclude” the information from being deemed Confidential Information.

judge.gold_summary: 金标认为并非所有保密信息都必须被披露方明确标识；即使没有“Confidential”标注，只要信息属于相关保密/专有信息或接收方被告知或有理由知道其保密，仍可构成保密信息。
judge.answer_summary: 系统回答称 NDA 不要求所有保密信息被明确标识或标记，并引用定义说明标注仅为推定，无标注也不排除构成保密信息。
judge.reason: 系统回答准确覆盖了金标的关键结论：不要求所有保密信息必须明确标识，且无标识不阻止信息被认定为保密信息。
